content.title: Peakstone (PKST) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Michael Escalante: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining our call today.  Through disciplined office sales, strong iOS leasing, and targeted iOS acquisitions, we have strengthened our balance sheet, reducing debt by approximately $450 million, improving total leverage to 5.4 times on a pro forma basis.  As of October 31, we've sold 12 office properties, totaling approximately $363 million, leaving just 12 remaining office properties in our portfolio.
